sub_parameters.name: DeviceName
sub_parameters.description: The device name of the shared device to be added.

sub_parameters.name: ProductKey
sub_parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the shared device to be added belongs.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Overview** tab of the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: SharePromotionActivityId
parameters.description:
The promotional activity ID.

The **Data** value returned by the **CreateSharePromotionActivity** operation.

parameters.name: ShareTaskCode
parameters.description:
The share code of the sharing task.

For more information about the share code, see [Use shared devices to broadcast shared corpora](~~607661~~).
